rundown: Panthers beat Retrievers 72-59 at Petersen Events Center in Pittsburgh, PA. Panthers led 43-23 at the half and never looked back. The 2nd quarter decided it: Panthers won it 28-10. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 75%).
Leading the way — Retrievers: Angela Williams 19 pts; Heidi Williams 3 ast, 10 reb. Panthers: Taryn Barbot 18 pts; Taylor Barbot 9 ast; Alancia Ramsey 10 reb.
Where Panthers won it: they shot 47% from three to 38%, won the boards 39-32 and had 14 assists to 13.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 18, 10:57 AM ET. It had Retrievers 10% and Panthers 90%, projecting Retrievers 59 – Panthers 75.7 (134.6 total, Panthers by 16.7).

Final: Retrievers 59 – Panthers 72. Right winner: it had Panthers at 90%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Retrievers came in with a 2% below average attack and a 4% stingier than average defense (4-1, 79 scored and 51.4 allowed a game over 5 games), worth about 161 and 160 games of evidence. Projected to score 59, they scored 59 (+0 points, 0% over); projected to allow 75.7, they allowed 72 (−3.7 points, 5% under).

Panthers came in with a 8% above average attack and a 6% stingier than average defense (4-0, 101 scored and 44.5 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 161 and 160 games of evidence. Projected to score 75.7, they scored 72 (−3.7 points, 5% under); projected to allow 59, they allowed 59 (+0 points, 0% over).

The bigger miss was Panthers' scoring (-3.7 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 131 against 134.6 projected (-3.6), about the 40th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14).

Margin: Panthers by 13 against Panthers by 16.7 projected, about the 39th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±13).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.953 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -2.4 points. It counts toward NCAAW scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 687 graded NCAAW games the algo now scales scoring ×0.980 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Retrievers attack ×1.004, defense ×1.002 (5 games); Panthers attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
